title: A note on the diameter of graphs of two-dimensional simplex codes
summary: Let $Γ^s(2,q)$ be the graph induced in the Grassmann graph by the $q$-ary simplex codes of dimension 2. For $q=4$, this graph is known to have diameter 3. We prove that the same diameter occurs for every prime power $q\geq5$. Together with the elementary cases $q=2,3$, this gives diam$Γ^s(2,q)=0,2,3$ for $q=2$, $q=3$, and $q\geq4$, respectively. The upper bound is obtained from a consequence of a theorem of Marshall Hall on finite abelian groups.
